definitions.explanation: The quality of being practical, useful, or functional in real-world situations. Often used to evaluate products, designs, or ideas.

examples.japanese: {実用性|じつようせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{実用性|じつようせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{鞄|かばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{実用性|じつようせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧。
examples.english: This bag looks simple, but it excels in practicality.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{実用|じつよう}→実用：04216_jitsuyou⟧ (practical use) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (quality/nature). Describes how useful or functional something is in practice, as opposed to being merely theoretical or decorative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実用性|じつようせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly practical
- {実用性|じつようせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in practicality
- {実用性|じつようせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧: to prioritize practicality
- {実用性|じつようせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack practicality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{利便性|りべんせい}→利便性：10681_ribensei⟧: convenience — focuses on ease of use rather than overall usefulness
- ⟦{機能性|きのうせい}→機能性：25513_kinousei⟧: functionality — focuses on how well features work
- ⟦{実用的|じつようてき}→実用的：12297_jitsuyouteki⟧: practical (na-adjective form) — used as a modifier rather than a standalone quality
